order.$description: Canonical order of the six designed guides (3x2 guide grids) and their colours; place.color = guide.color; non-guide places cycle this list. Guides added after the design (chava) have a colour but sit outside this order.

paco.$description: Cusco. design-system.md and design/Critterpass.dc.html name Paco's colour "cream" without a hex; no distinct cream primitive exists in either source, so this aliases the closest defined warm/cream primitive (paper.warm). Revisit on designer sign-off (design-system.md Unresolved Q1) with a token-only edit.
